CustomField.description: Days in pending finance approval phase. Blank when not in a pending phase.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Finance_Approval_Phase__c, 'DnB_Pending'), ISPICKVAL(Finance_Approval_Phase__c, 'KYC_Pending') ), NOT(ISBLANK(Finance_Approval_Phase_Changed__c)) ), TODAY() - Finance_Approval_Phase_Changed__c, NULL )
CustomField.label: Finance Approval Pending Days
